title: Hooded Figure by Eclipse
description: A hooded figure in a flowing white robe stands on an ornate stone balcony, looking toward a large black eclipse with a red corona in the dark sky. Large grayscale roses with golden centers grow from the balcony, with golden petals drifting through the air and scattered on the stone surface.
prompt: A solitary hooded figure in a long flowing white robe and cloak stands on an ancient stone balcony with carved symbols, turning away from the viewer to gaze at a massive black solar eclipse ringed in glowing red against a dark cosmic sky. Oversized grayscale roses with golden centers and thorny stems grow from the balcony, with golden petals swirling in the air and scattered across the stone ledge, in a surreal dark fantasy style with high contrast and atmospheric lighting.
